Crazy times! On July 22 we found a solution to one of the five major problems in quantum information theory usig Al. The problem is distillability or un-distillability of Werner states.
We checked the computations and they are correct.
The really crazy thing is this: just around this time there were 2 other groups who cracked this.
First there was a group who just recently posted a paper about this on arxiv, it appeared on July 23. Second, there was an announcement from a different group yesterday (July 24) with no arxiv but a public overleat. We can prove that we had the result before the arxiv paper appeared, and we can post our new paper on monday, it can appear on tuesday. So everybody was pretty much around the same time.
Interestingly, our proof is different from the one on arxiv.
Al model: ChatGPT 5.6 Sol
Human authors: Thomas C. Fraser, Felix Huber,
